title: One Steward run (a wake or a job run) as readable turns
description: Printed by `steward transcript <id> --json`, read only from Steward's own archive. One document per finished run; a run may hold several agent sessions (gsd-steady has two). Every declared key is present; null means unknown. Transcript and source text may be sent to the page host; secrets never: the producer redacts strings that look like credentials (bearer tokens, API keys, passwords in env assignments).
x-consumers: mech-d Page 2 transcript view (via the host runner, POST /api/transcript)

job.description: Job name for kind job; null for wakes

label.description: e.g. gsd step agent name (a, r1); null if none

name.description: Tool name for tool_call/tool_result; else null

text.description: Text, or the tool input as compact JSON, or the tool output

truncated.description: true if any text, turn list or the document size cap cut content

bytes.description: Size of the archived raw session files

x-limits: Serialized document at most 1,000,000 bytes: when over, drop the oldest tool_result texts first (keep the turn, set its text to '' and truncated true), then earlier turns.
